actions.name: HubSpot CRM Assistant - Message Handler
actions.description: Route each incoming chat message to the HubSpot CRM Agentic Worker (dw.agent) and reply with its answer

files.content:
pack_id: agentic-hubspot-crm-demo
version: 0.1.0
kind: application
publisher: Greentic
components: []
dependencies: []
flows:
- id: on_message
  file: flows/on_message.ygtc
  tags:
  - default
  entrypoints:
  - default
agents:
  hubspot_assistant:
    agent_id: hubspot_assistant
    system_prompt: "You are a HubSpot CRM assistant running as an Agentic Worker inside a Greentic flow. You help a sales and customer-success team manage their HubSpot CRM: contacts, deals, companies, and support tickets. Use hubspot_contacts, hubspot_deals, hubspot_companies, and hubspot_tickets (each takes an operation of create, search, update, or get) and hubspot_associate to link two records. Always search before creating a record to avoid duplicates. CREATING A RECORD: when the user asks to create a contact (or any record), do NOT create it immediately. First reply with a short confirmation that lists the fields you understood - for a contact: first name, last name, email, phone, company - writing 'not provided' for any field the user did not give, then ask the user to reply 'yes' to create or tell you what to change. Only after the user confirms (for example replies 'yes'), call the create operation with those fields and report the new record id and its HubSpot URL. If the user corrects a field, show the updated summary and ask for confirmation again. For updates and associations, confirm with the user before changing data. Always respond in English only - every reply, including greetings, must be written in English, even if the user writes to you in another language. Never invent record ids, properties, or results - only report what the tools return."
    tools:
      - extension_id: greentic.hubspot
        tool_name: hubspot_contacts
      - extension_id: greentic.hubspot
        tool_name: hubspot_deals
      - extension_id: greentic.hubspot
        tool_name: hubspot_companies
      - extension_id: greentic.hubspot
        tool_name: hubspot_tickets
      - extension_id: greentic.hubspot
        tool_name: hubspot_associate
    guardrails: []
    llm:
      provider: deepseek
      model: deepseek-chat
      credential_ref: deepseek
    limits:
      max_iter: 8
      timeout: 120

id: default
title: HubSpot CRM Assistant - Message Handler
description: Route each incoming chat message to the HubSpot CRM Agentic Worker (dw.agent) and reply with its answer; creating a record is confirmed in chat before it is written
type: messaging
start: assistant

nodes:
  # Single logic node: the HubSpot CRM Agentic Worker. It keeps multi-turn
  # session memory, so it can propose a create, wait for the user's 'yes',
  # then call the create tool - no card round-trip needed.
  assistant:
    dw.agent:
      user_text: "{{in.input.text}}"
    operation: hubspot_assistant
    routing:
      - to: send_reply

  send_reply:
    emit.response:
      messages:
        - type: text
          text: "{{node.assistant.reply}}"
    routing:
      - out: true

provider_id: agentic-hubspot-crm-demo
version: 1
title: HubSpot CRM Assistant — credentials
description: API keys for the agentic worker and its HubSpot CRM tools.
questions:
  - name: deepseek
    title: DeepSeek API key
    kind: string
    required: true
    secret: true
    help: "LLM API key for the agentic worker's reasoning loop (https://platform.deepseek.com)."
    group: LLM
    docs_url: "https://platform.deepseek.com"
    placeholder: "sk-..."
  - name: auth_method
    title: HubSpot connection method
    kind: choice
    required: true
    default: "Private App token"
    choices:
      - "Private App token"
      - "OAuth"
    help: "How the HubSpot tools authenticate. 'Private App token' (the default) uses a static token you paste below. 'OAuth' uses the platform OAuth broker with auto-refreshed tokens; the in-setup Connect button is coming in a platform update, so for now OAuth needs the broker provisioned first (see the setup guide)."
    group: HubSpot connection
    docs_url: "https://github.com/greentic-biz/component-hubspot-ext/blob/research/docs/oauth-setup.md"
  - name: access_token
    title: HubSpot Private App token
    kind: string
    required: true
    secret: true
    help: "HubSpot Private App access token used by the hubspot_* tools (https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/private-apps)."
    group: HubSpot connection
    docs_url: "https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/private-apps"
    placeholder: "pat-..."
    visible_if:
      field: auth_method
      eq: "Private App token"
  - name: auth_mode
    title: Connect HubSpot (OAuth)
    kind: oauth_connect
    required: false
    secret: true
    default: hubspot
    help: "Click Connect to authorize HubSpot via the platform OAuth broker, then return here. Requires a running broker (GREENTIC_OAUTH_BROKER_URL) that has a 'hubspot' provider and a HubSpot OAuth app; on success the demo uses broker-minted, auto-refreshed tokens and no Private App token is needed. On an older gtc without the Connect widget this shows as a text field — leave it blank and use Private App token instead."
    group: HubSpot connection
    docs_url: "https://github.com/greentic-biz/component-hubspot-ext/blob/research/docs/oauth-setup.md"
    visible_if:
      field: auth_method
      eq: "OAuth"
